instruction: Swap the two blocks using the empty mat, pressing the button after each move.

frames.label: Goal: swap the two cubes through the spare mat on the right. Move the cube that starts on the middle mat to the spare mat, move the left cube to the middle mat, then move the spare-mat cube to the left mat. After each of these three placements, press the orange button once and lift clear so it springs back up. A placed cube must rest near the center of its mat after release. Finish with the spare mat empty and both hands open and returned clear of the work. Progress: No move or button press is complete. The left and middle mats each hold a red cube, and the right mat is empty. The first cube to move is the one on the middle mat. Next: Point the right fingers down and travel above the middle cube with the jaws open. Why: The empty right mat provides temporary storage while the two occupied positions are exchanged. Start by freeing the middle mat; moving the left cube first would leave its destination occupied.
